Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever wondered what really shapes the way you see yourself and move through the world? Maybe you've asked yourself, "Who am I, really?" Well, you're not alone.
Together, we're about to explore the fascinating world of the Enneagram—a powerful guide for anyone ready to dig deeper into their own patterns, strengths, and the motivations that quietly steer our lives. If you're curious about the honest, sometimes surprising truths underneath your day-to-day choices, you're in the right place.
Drawing inspiration from Ian Morgan Cron's book, The Road Back to You: An Enneagram Journey to Self-Discovery, we'll uncover how the Enneagram's nine distinct personality types can help us spot our gifts, recognize our fears, and connect the dots between our inner world and the way we relate to others.
This isn't about putting anyone in a box—it's an invitation to look at ourselves gently and with curiosity. As we pay attention to those hidden habits and automatic reactions, we'll discover what it means to break free and step into a more wholehearted, authentic way of living.
So, whether you're hoping to grow in your relationships, find more meaning at work, or simply understand yourself a little better, this journey promises insight, empathy, and the freedom to become who you truly are. Let's take these next steps together and see what unfolds.
